title: Laurance Rockefeller's family pressured him over meeting Greer

tellings.quote: They didn't want he he said they are already jumping up and down on my nuts.

plain: In 1993, the millionaire Laurance Rockefeller is said to have met Steven Greer at the JY Ranch in Wyoming to talk about UFO secrets, even though his family, including his brother David Rockefeller and Jay Rockefeller, did not want him to. Greer tells Michels that Laurance complained the family was "already jumping up and down on my nuts" over it. If true, it would mean that one of America's richest families tried to keep one of its own away from the subject.
